slides.title:
Case interviews
in 30 seconds.
slides.body: Consulting firms hire PhDs from any field. This is the test.
slides.say: Consulting firms hire P H Ds from any field. But first, you face the case interview. Here it is in thirty seconds.

slides.title: Solve a business problem, live.
slides.body: Why did profits fall? Should the client enter a new market?
slides.say: The interviewer gives you a business problem, like why did profits fall, or should the client enter a new market. You solve it out loud.

slides.title: Use the same 5 steps.
slides.say: Use the same five steps. Clarify the goal. Structure the problem. Analyze the data. Say what it means. Then recommend.

slides.title: Lead with the answer.
slides.before: We looked at revenue, then costs, then...
slides.after: Profits fell because costs rose. Here's why.
slides.say: Tip one. Lead with the answer. Not, we looked at revenue, then costs, then. Instead, profits fell because costs rose. Here's why.

slides.title: Round your numbers.
slides.body: Roughly right in two minutes beats exact in ten.
slides.say: Tip two. Round your numbers. Roughly right in two minutes beats exact in ten.
